target_components.component_text: The upper element in early 㤅 is identified as 兂 in one analysis and 旡 in another; both are proposed as the sound component. The competing identifications are unresolved, and neither is the visible top of 爱.

sound_limitation.text: No pronunciation comparison for 兂 or 旡 in 㤅 is supplied; reconstructions for 愛 itself do not establish their proposed sound relationship.
